name: devpractice
description: A full-stack machine coding practice platform — microservices architecture

scripts.docker:build-runners: docker build -t devpractice-runner-node -f infra/docker/runners/node.Dockerfile . && docker build -t devpractice-runner-python -f infra/docker/runners/python.Dockerfile . && docker build -t devpractice-runner-java -f infra/docker/runners/java.Dockerfile .
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/gateway && npm install --prefix services/auth && npm install --prefix services/problems && npm install --prefix services/submissions && npm install --prefix services/execution && npm install --prefix services/notifications && npm install --prefix services/worker
